title: Definition
summary: A definition fixes how a new expression is to be used in terms of already available structure.

context.note: This node belongs to one explicit foundational presentation; alternate foundations may encode it differently.

assumptions.text: The declared formal or mathematical discourse context is fixed.

content.plain: A definition fixes how a new expression is to be used in terms of already available structure.
content.exact: A conservative explicit definition introduces a symbol d with a clause d(x) ↔ φ(x), where φ uses the prior language and uniqueness or admissibility conditions are stated when needed.
content.example: ‘n is even’ may be defined as ‘there exists k with n=2k’.
content.caveat: Definitions can conceal existence, uniqueness, type, or context assumptions unless those are exposed.
